sections.name: Hero
sections.feedback: Excellent. UVP present (zespół gotowy + wycena 24h), konkretne CTA z numerem, social proof bar. Brak forbidden words.

sections.name: Dlaczego My
sections.feedback: Strong. 4 USPs, każdy konkretny z decision-maker triggers. Brak pustych obietnic typu 'najwyższa jakość'.

sections.name: Dla Kogo Pracujemy
sections.feedback: Excellent. Segmentacja zgodna z marketing-guidelines: GW, deweloperzy, przemysł, prywatni. Każdy segment ma: kim + co + dlaczego.

sections.name: Usługi

issues.issue: Descriptions focus on features, could add more benefits
issues.fix: Optional: add 'co to daje klientowi' do każdej usługi

sections.feedback: Very strong. Technical expertise evident, 4 services with detailed scope. Minor: could emphasize benefits more.

sections.name: Jak Pracujemy
sections.feedback: Perfect per marketing-guidelines. 4 kroki, konkretne działania, przejrzysty proces.

sections.name: Realizacje

issues.issue: Realizacje missing specific numbers per marketing-guidelines
issues.rule_violated: marketing-guidelines.md: 'Każda realizacja ma: typ + zakres + 1 liczbę'
issues.fix: Add specific numbers: m², czas realizacji, np. '2500 m², 8 tygodni'

sections.feedback: Passes but weakest section. Has typ + zakres but missing liczby. Marketing-guidelines wymaga case study format z konkretnymi danymi.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.feedback: Excellent. 5 pytań z keywords, transparent answer about new company, helpful tone.

sections.name: Kontakt
sections.feedback: Perfect. Multiple CTA types (phone + email), complete contact info with NIP, clear next step.

decision.reasoning: All 8 sections pass (≥70%). Średnia 93%. Realizacje (85%) passes but noted for improvement - missing specific numbers per marketing-guidelines.

improvement_opportunity.name: Realizacje
improvement_opportunity.issue: Missing liczby (m², czas) per case study format

slop_check.real_business_owner_test: PASS - content sounds like real construction company, not agency copy

strengths: Sekcje 'Dla kogo' i 'Jak pracujemy' per marketing-guidelines
No forbidden words or marketing slop
summary.verdict: APPROVE - Quality content aligned with all 3 guidelines
